summary: Quick regression retest: verified silo-sync-button (data-testid) opens the 'Sync from Silo Base Mate' modal on click after the onClick handler fix. Logged in via owner magic link, opened farm 'default', clicked the header sync button — modal opened successfully with silo table (Silo A/B/C rows for Sheds 1&2..11&12), action buttons ('Correct today's entry', 'Add as new day', 'Clear All Silo Readings & Sync Today Only', 'Apply to Spreadsheet'), and no console errors surfaced.
test_credentials: Owner magic link provided in review request
context_for_next_testing_agent: The onClick={() => openSiloSync()} fix at App.tsx:12370 is verified working. Modal opens as expected. Readings show em-dashes (no live data in preview env) but modal UI loads fine.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: onClick={openSiloSync} passed the React SyntheticEvent as the isRetry param, which caused setShowSiloSync(true) to be skipped. Fixed by wrapping in an arrow function onClick={() => openSiloSync()} — confirmed by regression test.
